findings.evidence: `Isometry.mapsTo_sphere (hf : Isometry f) (x : α) (r : ℝ) : MapsTo f (Metric.sphere x r) (Metric.sphere (f x) r)` — Mathlib/Topology/MetricSpace/Isometry.lean:251; `protected theorem isometry [SemilinearIsometryClass 𝓕 σ₁₂ E E₂] (f : 𝓕) : Isometry f` — Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Operator/LinearIsometry.lean:87. The PR's own `norm_circleMapTransverse` (Transverse.lean:68) already proves the analogous norm fact with `rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map, norm_circleMap_zero]`, without the new lemma.
findings.fix: Drop the file and the declaration; at the two call sites use `LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map` together with `mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm`, exactly the pair already used at `GTMD/Transverse.lean:68`.
findings.issue: `SemilinearIsometryClass.norm_map_of_mem_sphere_zero` abstracts over `SemilinearIsometryClass` for no use — both call sites (`Average.lean:133`, `Average.lean:141`) pass the single concrete equiv `Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr` — and the fact already exists upstream in strictly greater generality (`Isometry.mapsTo_sphere`, `Mathlib/Topology/MetricSpace/Isometry.lean:251`, applicable via `SemilinearIsometryClass.isometry`, `Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Operator/LinearIsometry.lean:87`, for any isometry and any centre).

findings.evidence: Every ingredient of the proof exists at the ℂ level: `Real.circleAverage_neg_radius` (Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Integral/CircleAverage.lean:130), `Real.circleAverage_def` (:58), `norm_circleMap_zero` (Mathlib/Analysis/SpecialFunctions/Complex/CircleMap.lean:42), and `circleMap 0 (-R) θ = -circleMap 0 R θ` by `simp [circleMap]` — the same simp the PR uses at Transverse.lean:78. The transverse proof (Average.lean:148-161) invokes only `circleMapTransverse_neg_radius`, `norm_circleMapTransverse`, `circleAverageTransverse_neg_radius` and `_eq_integral`, each the transport of one of these.
findings.fix: Prove `Real.circleAverage_eq_zero_of_odd {f : ℂ → E} {R : ℝ} (hf : ∀ z, ‖z‖ = |R| → f (-z) = -f z) : Real.circleAverage f 0 R = 0` in the `EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/` area this PR already opens, and derive the transverse version by transport along `Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr`, as the other five `circleAverageTransverse_*` lemmas are derived.
findings.issue: `circleAverageTransverse_eq_zero_of_odd` is the one circle-average result in this PR that is not a transport of an existing Mathlib lemma, yet it is stated and proved only for `Transverse`. Its argument (`circleAverage f 0 (-R) = circleAverage f 0 R`, oddness on the sphere, halving) uses nothing about the transverse plane; the corresponding statement for `Real.circleAverage` on `ℂ` is unavailable to any other consumer.

summary: Two level problems: the new `SemilinearIsometryClass` lemma is a class-level abstraction with no class-level use that restates facts Mathlib already has more generally, and `circleAverageTransverse_eq_zero_of_odd` — the only new mathematics in the circle-average API — is proved only in the transverse special case although its proof uses nothing transverse.
